name: Lemon-Roasted Salmon with Dill-Yogurt Sauce & Greek Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
1 small bunch fresh dill
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes
3 English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Juice half of the lemons into a large baking dish. Add oil, vinegar, sugar, and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade. (Reserve remaining lemons for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the salmon dry with paper towels. Add to the baking dish with the marinade and turn to coat.
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until salmon is opaque and cooked through, about 12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between a small and a large bowl, then set the large bowl aside for the salad.
Juice reserved lemons into the small bowl with the dill. Add yogurt, mayo, and spices, then whisk to combine the sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add oil, vinegar, and spices to the large bowl with the dill, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onions. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl, along with feta, and stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad and salmon between plates or bowls. Top salmon with sauce and enjoy!
